description: A hardcoded DB password assigned to a $DB_PASS variable and used in mysqli_connect. Identifiers like $DB_PASS use the token 'pass', not 'password'/'pwd', so the aggressive rule missed them until 'pass' was added to the keyword set. The literal value (not a variable reference) must be confirmed, and it must be caught on its own assignment line rather than only via an incidental debug echo of the variable.
